test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a row of boys, Karun is 5th from the left and Panth is 6th from right. When they exchange their position, Karun becomes 13th from the left . What is the new position of Panth from the right?
solution:
1) Karun is 5th from the left and Panth is 6th from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/109f05157b8c770c50a06192dec1551743e5bc288fcbfd7e83f049f5c229e84b.png] 

2) When they exchange their position, Karun becomes 13th from the left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2c56175e2d0fe2c589fe29b0c5bf09f227db8b49dab9b1a23d588765bf92255.png]
